title: Apps Script in Google Workspace
context: Apps Script in Google Workspace. A session presented at the Google Workspace Developer Summit 2025.
established_channel_evidence: Official Google Workspace Developers publisher, linked from the Apps Script documentation video resources; search identifies this publisher.
relevance_reason: Apps Script is directly relevant to small-business automations and their execution limits.
contribution: For Apps Script automations, how do you test overlapping trigger runs before using live business data? A duplicate-input test with a stable request ID can reveal whether the same record would be processed twice. I would check both concurrency protection and a processed-record check.
